newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HAECO signs 20-yr airport contract.
newsitem.headline: HAECO signs 20-yr airport contract.

text.p: Hong Kong's Airport Authority said it signed an agreement on Wednesday with Hong Kong Aircraft Engineering Co Ltd (HAECO) on aircraft maintenance at the territory's new airport which will be operational in 1988.
Under the pact, HAECO would provide base and line aircraft maintenance services at the new Chek Lap Lok airport for 20 years, the Authority said in a statement.

The firm, which has been providing aircraft maintenance at the existing airport for more than 40 years, would invest about HK$1.4 billion to develop a three-bay hangar with adjoining workshops at the new airport's west end for base maintenance.
